lanes.summary: The review is complete. F3 is fully tested on 100% of the corpus via `parseable_corpus()`, which asserts the collection corresponds to directory listings and does not pass on an empty set. The YAML format strictly forbids aliases and local tags, preventing smuggled executable objects (billion-laughs), and validates AST trees against the grammar to reject inexpressible structures. Deserialization is safely bounded. There is exactly one checker as `check_yaml` parses the YAML to a `Program`, formats it back to an RHL string, and delegates to the text checker (`check()`). The diagnostic catalogue is append-only, keeping `RHL-P001` intact while adding `RHL-P004`. The `tree.rs` serde changes did not impact JSON diagnostics because the tool reports serialize `Report` and `Diagnostic` structures, not the AST nodes themselves. No vacuous tests were found; the positive control and corpus validation tests enforce explicit failure modes.

lanes.summary: Review of git diff main...RHLGA-P3-rhl3 (head be241c04): Row RHL-3 of spec docs/specifications/ruchy-high-level-language-interface.md and plan docs/rhl/rhlga-1-plan.md §3 P3 is fully verified. (1) F3 is tested over 100% of parseable corpus files (144 files across v1 and v2, valid and planted), dynamically discovered via read_dir and tied to directory listings with anti-vacuity assertions (ok.len() > 30 and ok.len() + missing_end == all.len()). (2) from_yaml cannot express a tree the RHL grammar cannot produce because grammatical() re-parses the formatted normal form and compares trees; local YAML tags, unknown fields, and top-level alias bombs are strictly rejected; deserialization is bounded. (3) Exactly one checker exists (RHL-001 §9.5): check_yaml delegates directly to the standard check() function on formatted RHL text. (4) Diagnostic codes: RHL-P004 is appended at the end of CATALOGUE; RHL-P001 keeps 'missing end'; diagnostic-codes.md is append-only and verified in sync. (5) tree.rs serde attributes do not affect Diagnostic/Report JSON outputs or v1/v2 tests (all 209 rhl lib tests and 10 rhl_cli tests pass). (6) No vacuous tests exist. Verdict: PASS.
